BookMeta.description: Who wrote one book of the Bible, where, and when.

author.description: The book's author, as this atlas records him.

write_from.description: The earliest year it is dated to, negative for BC; absent when undated.

write_place.description: Where it was written, absent when that is not recorded.

write_to.description: The latest year it is dated to; absent when undated.

CanonBook.description:
One book of the canon: its code, its name, and how many verses each of its
chapters holds.

chapters.description: The verse count of each chapter, in order.

CatechismItem.description:
One catechism item in full, with the chief part of the catechism it sits
under.

explanation_heading.description: The question the explanation answers, such as "What does this mean?".

part_title.description: The chief part this item belongs to, such as Baptism.

text.description:
The item's own words -- a commandment, a petition, an article -- absent for
an item that has none.

where_written.description:
Where in Scripture the item's own words are written, absent when it quotes
none.

CatechismProofVerse.description:
One proof verse of a catechism item, carrying the verse in full rather than
a preview.

question.description:
The question this verse was cited under, absent when the item cites it
directly.

CatechismRef.description:
One catechism item citing a verse or a span: enough to name it and to fetch
it in full.

provenance.description:
The sources behind this response's catechism citations. Every element of one
response carries the same set; `/api/sources` names each id.

question.description:
The question the verse was cited under, absent when the item cites it
directly.

Chapter.description: One chapter of Scripture, verse by verse.

Contents.description: One corpus's contents, as a tree two levels deep.

version.description: A stamp identifying the data set this tree was read from.

ContentsChild.description: A second-level entry: a chapter of a book, or an article of a document.

count.description: How many members it holds: verses of a chapter, paragraphs of an article.

ref.description:
The reference to open for this entry: `GEN.1` for a chapter, or an
article's first paragraph, such as `BoC 7.2.1`.

ContentsChildKind.description:
Whether a second-level entry of a corpus's contents is a chapter of a book
or an article of a document. The contents tree goes no deeper than this.

ContentsRoot.description:
A top-level entry: a book of the Bible, or a document of the Book of
Concord.

children.description: The entry's chapters, or its articles.

oneOf.description:
Which half of the canon the book belongs to; absent for a Concord document,
which belongs to neither.

ref.description: The reference to open when this entry is chosen: its first child's.

ContentsRootKind.description:
Whether a top-level entry of a corpus's contents is a book of the Bible
or a document of the Book of Concord.

Contract.description:
The range of contract versions this server answers for, and the schema
versions of the data behind them.

manifest_schema.description: The schema version of the compiled data set the responses are read from.

max_version.description: The newest contract version this server answers for.

min_version.description: The oldest contract version this server answers for, as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

section_schema_version.description: The schema version of the individual sections that data set is made of.

Corpus.description:
A body of text this API serves a reading spine for: Scripture, or the
Book of Concord.

CrossRef.description:
One cross reference: where it points, how strongly it is attested, and a
look at the text there.

preview.description: The text of the target's first verse.

provenance.description:
The sources behind this response's cross references. Every element of one
response carries the same set; `/api/sources` names each id.

target.description: The reference pointed at: one verse, or a span.

votes.description: How many readers voted for this reference. Higher sorts first.

EdgeEntry.description: One neighbour, with the edge that joins it.

edge.description:
The edge's own id. The neighbour's page for the opposite kind carries this
same id for this same connection, and the edge itself can be explored.

EdgePage.description: One page of a node's neighbours of a single kind.

next.description: Pass this back as `cursor` for the following page; absent on the last page.

version.description: A stamp identifying the data set this page was read from.

EdgeSummaryEntry.description: How many neighbours of one kind something has.

Era.description: A named stretch of this atlas's timeline.

from_year.description: The first year of the era, negative for BC.

to_year.description: The last year of the era.

EventAnalogue.description:
One event whose account resembles another's -- similar in form or in content,
never a second account of the same happening.

provenance.description:
The id of the source that asserts the resemblance. A resemblance is a claim
of its own, so this is neither event's own source.

EventDetail.description: One event, or one titled passage, in full.

acts_section.description:
The section of the outline of Acts this event falls in, absent when it has
none.

analogues.description:
Events whose accounts resemble this one without being accounts of it.
Omitted when there are none.

atlas_section.description:
The titled section of this atlas's own outline of Scripture, absent when it
has none.

kind.description:
`event` for something that happened at a date, `general` for a titled
passage that has none.

kjv_superscription.description:
The superscription the King James Version prints over this passage, absent
when it prints none.

mentioned_in.description:
The verses that mention this event without narrating it, in canonical order.
Omitted when there are none.

mentions_provenance.description:
The sources behind the verses that mention this event. Omitted when there are
none.

provenance.description: The id of the source that asserts this event; `/api/sources` names it.

ref_note.description:
A note on how this event's date and grouping were arrived at, absent when
none was needed.

robertson_section.description:
The section of Robertson's Harmony of the Gospels this event falls in, absent
when it has none.

oneOf.description: The years the event spans; absent for a titled passage that has no date.

witnesses.description: The passages that narrate this event, one per book. Always at least one.

witnesses_provenance.description:
The sources behind the passages that narrate this event, for this event
rather than for the corpus. Omitted when there are none.

EventWitness.description:
One book's account of an event: the passage it narrates the event in, and any
note on the citation.

Heading.description:
The pericope heading that belongs above one verse: the container it names,
its title, that container's kind, and whether this verse merely continues
coverage that began in an earlier chapter rather than opening it.

History.description:
What is known about a place's name and existence over time, resolved for the
years asked about.

blurb.description: A short description of the place in those years, absent when none applies.

oneOf.description: When the place was destroyed, absent when that is not recorded.

display_name.description:
The name this place bore in the years asked about, falling back to its
default name when no period name applies.

oneOf.description: When the place was founded, absent when that is not recorded.

version.description: A stamp identifying the data set this commentary was read from.

KretzmannChapterItem.description: One commentary item: the id that fetches its prose, and its heading.

heading.description: Absent for an item with no heading of its own.

KretzmannChapterVerse.description:
One verse's commentary items, in document order. Only verses with at least
one item appear at all.

LandMask.description:
The coastline geometry border washes are clipped against, so no polity's
colour spills into open sea.

rings.description: Closed rings of [latitude, longitude] points, in degrees.

Landmark.description:
An always-on map label: a water, a mountain or a region, drawn at one point
and never interactive.

size.description:
A size hint -- `sm`, `md` or `lg` -- for a label meant to stay readable when
zoomed out; absent for most landmarks.

Narrative.description:
A journey or storyline through the atlas: an ordered chain of events the map
draws as a run of arrows.

color.description: The colour its arrows are drawn in.

legs.description: The ids of its events, in order, never running backwards in time.

NarrativeAdjacentEvent.description:
An event next to the one asked about: enough to show it, and the id to travel
to it with.

NarrativeEventPositions.description:
Where one event sits in time: in each narrative it belongs to, and in the
atlas's whole chronology.

oneOf.description: The event's place in the whole chronology; absent for an event with no date.

NarrativePosition.description: One event's place in one narrative, with the legs on either side of it.

oneOf.description: The leg after this one; absent at the narrative's last leg.
The leg before this one; absent at the narrative's first leg.

NodeCard.description:
One node of the graph at a glance: what it is, what to call it, where it
came from, and what it connects to.

description.description:
Public-domain dictionary or commentary prose about this node, absent when
none is recorded. Never invented.

edge_summary.description:
How many neighbours this node has of each kind, listing only the kinds it
has any of.

oneOf.description: Life facts, present only for a person.

provenance.description: The id of the source that asserts this node; `/api/sources` names it.

version.description: A stamp identifying the data set this card was read from.

NodeRef.description:
A reference to something the graph holds: enough to show it, and the id to
fetch it with. The `kind` is one of the graph's node kinds, or `Edge` when
the reference is to an edge, which can be explored in its own right.

PersonLife.description: What is recorded about one person's life.

also_called.description: Other names this person is known by.

birth_year.description:
The year of birth where one is recorded, negative for BC; most people have
none.

death_year.description: The year of death where one is recorded.

eternal.description:
True for a person Scripture presents as eternal, who therefore carries no
years at all.

eternal_grounds.description: The verses on which that is claimed.

first_year.description:
The earliest year at which this person is mentioned -- the span of mentions,
never a lifespan.

gender.description: Absent when the source records none.

last_year.description: The latest year at which this person is mentioned.

PersonRef.description:
A person the graph attests at a verse -- never a name matched against the
text -- with the id to explore and the name to show for it.

PlaceDateClaim.description: A date this atlas claims for a place, with the verses it rests on.

note.description:
A qualifier such as `traditional`, shown as a leading "c." on the date;
absent when the date needs none.

when.description: The year claimed, or the range; a single year is a span whose ends are equal.

PlaceDetail.description:
One place: where it is, the events that happened there, and what is known
about its name and its history.

canonical_name.description:
The place's plain canonical name, present only when the name being shown is
a period name or a translation's own wording and so differs from it.

description.description:
Public-domain dictionary prose about the place, absent when none is
recorded. Never invented.

oneOf.description: Absent for a place with no curated history.

PlaceRef.description:
A place named by something else on this response: its id, to explore or to
target on the map, and the name to show for it.

Polities.description: The polity borders in view for the span of years asked about.

Polity.description:
One era of one polity's border. The `id` and `color_key` are the polity's
and hold across every era row it contributes; the name, the years and the
rings belong to this era alone.

color_key.description: A number fixed per polity, so its eras can be coloured consistently.

oneOf.description: The event that ended this polity for good, absent when none is recorded.

from.description: The first year of this era, negative for BC.

name.description: The polity's name during this era.

rings.description:
This era's border, as closed rings of [latitude, longitude] points, in
degrees.

to.description: The last year of this era.

oneOf.description: The event that opened this era, absent when none is recorded.

PolityDelta.description:
The event at one boundary of a polity's era: its rise, a change of its
borders, or its fall.

event.description: A short description of what happened.

ref_note.description: The sources actually consulted for this event.

verses.description:
The verses grounding it. May be empty for an event history records but no
single verse pinpoints; never a fabricated reference.

ProvenanceEntry.description:
The join between a provenance id as records carry it and the source that
names, describes and licenses it.

confidence.description:
How the claim was arrived at: `CanonicalText`, `Curated`, `Imported` or
`Derived`.

id.description: The provenance id exactly as a record carries it.

locator.description:
What inside the named source this id draws on, absent when the source's own
description already says.

source.description: The id of the source this is a claim by.

QuietPlace.description:
A place this atlas knows an event at, drawn on the map but not lit for the
span asked about.

display_name.description: The name to show, resolved for the same span the lit places use.

existence_from.description: The year this place was founded, where that is recorded; absent otherwise.

existence_to.description: The year it ceased to exist, where that is recorded; absent otherwise.

merged_ids.description:
The ids of other records for this same place, folded into this one. Omitted
when there are none.

total_events.description:
How many events touch this place in any year. A count for the span asked
about would always be zero, which is what makes the place quiet.

Scene.description:
The map at one moment of enquiry: which places are lit, which are only
present, and which arrows run between them.

arrows.description: The movements narratives draw between the places in view.

narratives.description: The narratives with at least one leg in view.

places.description: The places something in view happens at.

quiet_places.description:
Every other place this atlas knows an event at: present on the map but not
lit. Always sent, and always empty for a passage.

ref.description: The passage asked about; absent when a span of years was asked about instead.

oneOf.description: The span of years asked about; absent when a passage was asked about instead.

SceneArrow.description:
One leg of a narrative drawn on the map: a movement from one place to the
next.

color.description: The colour that narrative is drawn in.

from_event.description: The id of the event at the starting place.

from_place.description: The id of the place the movement starts from.

narrative.description: The id of the narrative this leg belongs to.

order.description: This leg's position along the narrative, counting from its first.

to_event.description: The id of the event at the arriving place.

to_place.description: The id of the place it arrives at.

SceneEvent.description: One event at a place: when it happened, and where it is narrated.

verse_groups.description: The passages narrating it, grouped by book and chapter.

SceneMode.description:
Which question a scene answers: what was happening in a span of years,
or where a passage happens.

SceneNarrative.description: One narrative with at least one leg in view.

color.description: The colour its arrows are drawn in.

legs_in_scene.description: How many of its legs are in view.

ScenePlace.description: One lit place on the map, with the events that light it.

brightness.description:
How brightly to draw this place, from how much of what is in view happens
here.

display_name.description:
The name to show: the one this place bore in the span asked about, or its
default name when no period name applies.

existence_from.description: The year this place was founded, where that is recorded; absent otherwise.

existence_to.description: The year it ceased to exist, where that is recorded; absent otherwise.

merged_ids.description:
The ids of other records for this same place, folded into this one. Omitted
when there are none.

SourceCategory.description: One heading the sources are grouped under.

id.description: The key a source's `category` points at.

SourceEntry.description:
One source this atlas is built from: what it is, what was built from it, and
how it is licensed.

category.description: The id of the heading this source is grouped under.

license.description: The licence it is used under, quoted rather than paraphrased.

licenses_row_key.description:
A key that ties this entry to its row in the project's licence file, so the
two cannot drift apart. Not meant to be displayed.

link.description: Where to find the source, absent when it has no public home.

what_it_is.description: What the source is, in a sentence or two.

what_we_built.description: What this atlas built from it.

SourcesDocument.description:
Everything this atlas is built from: the sources, the headings they are
grouped under, and the ids that tie individual records back to a source.

provenances.description:
The join from the provenance id a record carries to the source that asserts
it.

Testament.description: Which half of the canon a book belongs to: the Old Testament, or the New.

TextUnit.description:
One unit of a reading spine: a verse of Scripture, or a paragraph of the
Book of Concord.

edge_summary.description:
How many neighbours this unit has of each kind, so a page can tell which
units lead somewhere without asking after each one.

words_of_christ.description:
The spans of `text` that are the words of Christ, in order. Always empty
outside Scripture.

TextWindow.description: A window of one corpus's reading spine.

next.description:
The reference one step further on in the direction travelled; absent at the
end of the corpus.

version.description: A stamp identifying the data set this window was read from.

TimeRange.description:
A span of years on this atlas's scale: negative for BC, positive for AD, with
no year zero. A single year is a span whose ends are equal.

TimelinePosition.description:
Where an event sits in the atlas's whole chronology, whatever narratives it
belongs to.

Verse.description: One verse: its text, and what the graph attests at it.

oneOf.description:
The heading that belongs above this verse, present only where the verse opens
one.

persons.description: The people this verse names. Empty for most verses.

places.description: The places this verse names, in a stable order. Empty for most verses.

words_of_christ.description:
The spans of `text` that are the words of Christ, in order. Empty for most
verses.

xref_count.description: How many cross references start at this verse; 0 for most of them.

VerseDetail.description: One verse in full, with everything the graph attaches to it.

book_meta.description: Who wrote this verse's book, where and when.

catechism.description: The catechism items citing this verse. Empty for most verses.

catechism_provenance.description: The sources behind the catechism citations above.

cross_refs.description: This verse's cross references, most strongly attested first.

cross_refs_provenance.description:
The sources behind the cross references above. Always present, and empty when
there are none.

events.description: The events and titled passages this verse belongs to, oldest first.

provenance.description: The id of the source this verse's text comes from; `/api/sources` names it.

words_of_christ.description:
The spans of `text` that are the words of Christ, in order. Empty for most
verses.

VerseEvent.description: One event or titled passage a verse belongs to.

kind.description:
`event` for something that happened at a date, `general` for a titled
passage that has none.

places.description: The ids of the places it touches.

provenance.description:
The id of the source that asserts the event this verse belongs to;
`/api/sources` names it.

verse_groups.description: The passages it is narrated in, grouped by book and chapter.

oneOf.description: The years the event spans; absent for a titled passage that has no date.

VerseGroup.description: A run of verses from one chapter of one book.

book.description: The book's three-letter code, such as `GEN`.

count.description: How many verses the group covers in all.

verses.description: The verse numbers and ranges covered, such as `3` or `3-5`.

WordsOfChristSpan.description:
One span of the words of Christ within a verse's text: character offsets into
it, half-open, so the span is the text from `start` up to but not including
`end`.
